content.title: Rule 1: Be Kind and Respectful
content.desc: This is a nice, friendly community, where hate speech or harassment will not be tolerated in messages or your profile.

content.title: Rule 2: No NSFW
content.desc: No sexual, gore or illegal content. Keep it PG-13!

content.title: Rule 3: No Spam
content.desc: Avoid spamming, trolling, heavy tagging/DMing and excessive self-promotion. Do not post unsolicited links/invites in channels and in member's DMs.

content.title: Rule 4: Stay On Topic
content.desc: Try to stay on topic within channels. Especially in help channels

content.title: Rule 5: Politics
content.desc: Be cautious of introducing divisive discussions of laws, political candidates, etc. There's no such thing as keeping politics out of games

content.title: Rule 6: No Memes
content.desc: All users must follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

content.title: Rule 7: No Piracy
content.desc: No discussions of cracking or pirating software

content.title: Rule 8: English Only
content.desc: Please keep all messages and images in English.

content.title: Compromised Account
content.desc: Your account has been compromised. You have been removed from the server, and your messages from the past hour has been removed.
